newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FELS raises stake in KIE.
newsitem.headline: FELS raises stake in KIE.

text.p: Far East Levington Shipbuilding Ltd (FELS) has increased its stake in Keppel Integrated Engineering Ltd (KIE) to 20 percent from 6.7 percent, Keppel Corp Ltd said on Monday.
The diversified shipyard company said in a statement the move was part of its plans to rationalise its industrial engineering business.
FELS acquired 13.3 million KIE shares at Singapore $0.50 each from another Keppel group Singmarine Industries Ltd for about Singapore $19.3 million.
It added KIE is divesting its interest in FELS China Ltd which will become a wholly owned subsidiary of FELS before the year end. KIE is disposing its 25 percent stake to FELS for S$5.2 million.
As at October 31, FELS has a 5.7 percent interest in the issued capital of Singmarine.
FELS, Singmarine and KIE are subsidiaries of Keppel Corp which has 56.2 percent, 64.8 percent and 62.5 percent interest in the three companies respectively.
